value.name: Task
value.description: Tracks work that needs to be done.

value.name: Bug
value.description: Describes a divergence between required and actual behavior, and tracks the work done to correct the defect and verify the correction.

value.name: Code Review Request
value.description: Represents the master work item for a code review. Child work items should be created of the type Code Review Response.

value.name: Code Review Response
value.description: This is a child work item that should be parented to a Code Review Request work item. It is assigned to the reviewer and contains the current state of the review for this reviewer.

value.name: Epic
value.description: Epics help teams effectively manage and groom their product backlog

value.name: Feature
value.description: Tracks a feature that will be released with the product

value.name: Feedback Request
value.description: Represents the master work item for a feedback session. Child work items should be created of the type Feedback Response.

value.name: Feedback Response
value.description: This is a child work item that should be parented to a Feedback Request work item. It is assigned to the reviewer and contains the current state of the review for this reviewer.

value.name: Product Backlog Item
value.description: Tracks an activity the user will be able to perform with the product.

value.name: Shared Steps
value.description: Server-side data for reusable set of test steps.

value.name: Shared Parameter
value.description: Server-side data for reusable set of parameters.

value.name: Test Case
value.description: Server-side data for a set of steps to be tested.

value.name: Test Plan
value.description: Tracks test activities for a specific milestone or release.

value.name: Test Suite
value.description: Tracks test activites for a specific feature, requirement, or user story.
